Name: Shen's Farmhouse Interior for Content Patcher
Author: cuttlefishen
Description:
[center][size=4]﻿Do you watch way too much of HGTV's Fixer Upper?
Do you wish for lighter, more colorful, pastel interiors?
Do you have a desperate clawing need for granite countertops and farmhouse sinks?[/size]

[b][i][size=5]IF YOU SAID YES TO ANY OF THESE QUESTIONS
THEN HAVE I GOT THE MOD FOR YOU!!!

[s]HI, BILLY MAYS HERE-[/s][/size][/i][/b][/center][center][/center][center].........

So anyway this is my first published mod, and it's still a work in progress, so plz go easy on me.
This is a replacer for the farmhouse tiles file which contains the sprites for your farmhouse's kitchen, beds, and crib. The colors and design were inspired by the work of Joanna Gaines from Fixer Upper... with some aspects inspired by random "farmhouse furniture" searches on pinterest...
Enjoy~!

[b][size=3]Future Plans:[/size][/b]
* Add open shelf with books and such in gap over sink.
* Recolor wall borders.
* Edit small bed to match.
*Add optional recolors - Feel free to request specifics!
* Add blanket or stuffed animal into crib?
* Redesign oven to be a glass top?
[/center][center][size=3]﻿[/size][b][size=3]Requirements:[/size]
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][center]Content Patcher[/center][/url]﻿
[center][b][i][size=3]INSTALLS IN 3 EASY STEPS![/size][/i]
[/b]1. Make sure SMAPI & Content Patcher are up to date.
2. Download & Unzip file.
3. Place in the ﻿“\Stardew Valley\Mods” folder.
[i][b][size=3]
[/size][/b][/i][/center][center]﻿[/center][center][size=6]BUT WAIT THERE'S MORE!!![/size]
[size=4][i]Call now and we'll throw in our matching Wallpaper and Flooring Mod too![/i][/size]
[size=4][i]That's TWO mods for the price of ONE![/i][/size]
[size=4][i]This NEXUS EXCLUSIVE deal can't be found ANYWHERE ELSE, so download now before this deal EXPIRES!!!
[/i][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2919]Shen's Wallpaper and Flooring[/url]﻿[/size]

[size=1][color=#b6b6b6]Advertised price doesn't include the cost shipping and handling because there is nothing to ship or handle because this is a downloaded mod and also there's no actual advertised price because this mod is free. What do you think this is, Steam? Nah fam this is all just a goof. I really hope you've been reading all this in some sort of infomercial narrator voice especially this fine print which i hope has been read as fast as possible because otherwise the bit won't land as well and I feel like I've worked harder on this bit than I did on the actual mod, especially since I had to type this fine print out all twice because the first time nexus freaked and deleted it when I was just trying to move it down. Anyway the bit's over thanks for reading all this if you did you get a cookie love yall kthxbai.[/color]

[/size][/center]
